payload.artist_html: G. E. Spicher, W. G. Joyce, P. Gueriau, K. Peyer, V. Reneleau & J. Anquetin
payload.credit_html: "A revision of the fossil turtles of the Late Jurassic locality of Canjuers, France, and description of a new thalassochelydian species"
payload.description_html: Cranium of MNHN.F.CNJ77 (Caesaria templaria) from Canjuers. A, photograph; B, interpretative line drawing. Abbreviations: art, articular; bo, basioccipital; ex, exoccipital; fr, frontal; fst, foramen stapedio-temporale; mx, maxilla; na, nasal; op, opistothic; pa, parietal; pal, palatine; pf, prefrontal; pm, premaxilla; qu, quadrate; so, supraoccipital; sq, squamosal; sur, surangular. Cranial sulci are indicated by thicker green lines and uncertain sutures with dashed lines. Hatched surfaces represent areas where the original exposed bony surface has been lost. Scale bar equals 1 cm.
